name: Fischl
source: A Genshin Impact character who is a chuunibyou girl from Mondstadt. She calls herself the "Prinzessin der Verurteilung" who once ruled the "Immernachtreich." Wields an Electro Vision and works at the Adventurer's Guild.
translation: A Genshin Impact character who is a chuunibyou girl from Mondstadt. She calls herself the "Prinzessin der Verurteilung" who once ruled the "Immernachtreich." Wields an Electro Vision and works at the Adventurer's Guild.
